item.title: Ask HN: Cloudflare Smart Placement
item.summary: I moved my app to Cloudflare a few weeks back to test the app on the server. It's been three weeks, and even after daily usage of 10 minutes per day, the worker still resides in India, while my database lives in US East 2. Any recommendations to speed this up? Because navigating the app is painfully slow for now. It's so slow that I don't want to open it up for private beta as well.
